captions.detailed: A floor-standing bicycle pump with a wide black rectangular base plate, a central grey vertical barrel, and two black side-support struts. A black T-handle is mounted on a metallic silver plunger rod that slides vertically into the barrel. A circular pressure gauge is attached near the bottom of the barrel, complete with a small, red, spring-loaded pressure-release button on its housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a workshop floor pump. It should feature a wide rectangular foot base, a central vertical cylinder barrel supported by dual side struts, and a T-handle with a silver rod that slides vertically. Include a circular pressure gauge at the base with a small red pressure-release button.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat box combined with two square foot pads. Model the central barrel as a cylinder with a top collar, and support it with angled rectangular side struts. Create the T-handle using a horizontal cylinder joined to a central vertical sleeve, and attach it to a thin silver cylinder representing the plunger rod. Model the pressure gauge as a short, wide cylinder at the base, and add a small red cylinder for the pressure-release button.
